title: Lychee Coconut Bubble Tea
changes_from_base: Blended into a slush with lychees, coconut milk and jasmine tea instead of black tea and milk; the pearls are soaked in a light brown sugar syrup.
summary: A tropical twist on bubble tea: jasmine tea, lychees and coconut milk blended into a frosty slush and poured over chewy pearls soaked in brown sugar syrup.

ingredients.item: drained canned lychees, plus 2 tbsp of their syrup

steps.title: Tea
steps.text: Steep the jasmine tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, then remove them and chill the tea until cold.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Boil the sugar and water together in a small pan for 2 minutes, stirring until dissolved, then take it off the heat.

steps.title: Pearls
steps.text: Cook the pearls in plenty of boiling water as the packet directs, usually 5 minutes and then 2-3 minutes covered off the heat, until chewy all the way through. Transfer them straight into the warm syrup and leave for 20 minutes to absorb its sweetness.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the cold tea with the lychees and their syrup, coconut milk, milk, lime juice and ice until thick, smooth and slushy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the pearls and their syrup into the glasses, pour the slush on top and serve with wide straws.

tips: Undercooked pearls stay hard in the middle; bite one before draining.
Chilling the pearls makes them tough, so cook them no more than 4 hours ahead.
Shake the coconut milk can well first; the cream separates on standing.
storage: Drink the slush right away. Cooked pearls keep at room temperature in syrup for up to 4 hours. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
